sn51.32:1.3: katamesaṃ dhammānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā tathāgato evaṃmahiddhiko evaṃmahānubhāvoti.
sn51.32:2.2: catunnaṃ kho bhikkhave, iddhipādānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā tathāgato evaṃmahiddhiko evaṃmahānubhāvo.
sn51.32:3.2: idha bhikkhave, tathāgato chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti.
sn51.32:3.3: iti me chando na ca atilīno bhavissati. na ca atippaggahito bhavissati. …pe…
sn51.32:3.8: iti vivaṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsaṃ cittaṃ bhāveti.
sn51.32:3.12: iti me vīmaṃsā na ca atilīnā bhavissati, na ca atipaggahitā bhavissati. na ca ajjhattaṃ saṃkhittā bhavissati, na ca bahiddhā vikkhittā bhavissati.
sn51.32:3.14: ‘yathā pure tathā pacchā, yathā pacchā tathā pure,
sn51.32:3.15: yathā adho tathā uddhaṃ yathā uddhaṃ tathā adho,
sn51.32:3.16: yathā divā tathā rattiṃ yathā rattiṃ tathā divā.’
sn51.32:3.17: iti vivaṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsaṃ cittaṃ bhāveti.
sn51.32:3.18: imesaṃ ca kho pana bhikkhave, catunnaṃ iddhipādānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā tathāgato evaṃmahiddhiko evaṃmahānubhāvo.
sn51.32:4.1: imesañca pana bhikkhave, catunnaṃ iddhipādānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā tathāgato anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhoti: ekopi hutvā bahudhā hoti …pe… yāva brahmalokāpi kāyena vasaṃ vatteti.
sn51.32:4.2: imesañca pana bhikkhave, catunnaṃ iddhipādānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā tathāgato āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatīti.
sn51.32:5.3: ānandena duve vuttā bhikkhūsambahule duve, ekādaso
